title: Word order and emphasis
subtitle: Observe prominence after grammar, not instead of grammar.
overview: Greek word order is flexible because endings carry much of the grammatical load. A fronted or repeated element may be prominent, but placement alone does not prove emphasis.
Parse every form first. Then notice placement, contrast, repetition, and particle position as converging evidence.

items.grc: ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου.
items.en: You are the light of the world.

items.grc: οὐχ ὑμεῖς με ἐξελέξασθε, ἀλλ᾽ ἐγὼ ἐξελεξάμην ὑμᾶς.
items.en: You did not choose me, but I chose you.
